title: a new compatibility shim, by its words
how: phrases (not single words) that describe keeping an old form alive, in comments and strings: old name, keeps resolving, still accepted, for old links, folds into, falls back to. CLAUDE.md: change every caller and delete the old form

explain.what: A comment or a string uses words that describe keeping an old form alive: old name, still accepted, falls back to, for old links.
explain.why: A compatibility shim keeps old behaviour working after a rename. It is tech debt: two ways stay alive, and nobody knows when the old one may go (CLAUDE.md, No compatibility shims).
explain.fix: Change every caller, link, test and doc to the new form, and delete the old one. If the words describe something else, reword them.

patterns: \b(?:[Oo]ld names?|keeps? resolving|still accepted|for old links|folds? into|falls? back to)\b
